verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents Jupyter as a first-class connection method. PyTorch templates come ready with Jupyter, the instance portal auto-creates Cloudflare tunnels for open ports, and a direct Jupyter connection option exists. VS Code support is mentioned only briefly, alongside SSH terminal access. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Jupyter or IDE connection happens in a single step, any mention of Cursor, detailed VS Code/IDE remote-connection docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step
